name: Home server / VPS
summary: The agent runs 24/7 on hardware or a virtual server you control, such as a Raspberry Pi, a spare Mac or a small cloud VPS. This keeps schedules, webhooks and chat connections alive without depending on a managed agent platform, in exchange for doing your own updates, backups and security.
how: Provision a home machine or a VPS
Install the agent (often with Docker) as a long-running service
Connect chat channels and expose webhooks through a tunnel or reverse proxy
Set up restarts, backups and updates
facts: OpenClaw (guides for Linux VPS, Hetzner, Raspberry Pi), Hermes Agent
Always-on and under your control, but you own uptime and security
watchOut: You patch, back up and secure the box
Exposed endpoints and stored API keys are an attack surface
Single machine means single point of failure
